scope: Strengthen the four recovered Free Update 20 / 4th Festival skill identities using independent skill/preset evidence while preserving the canonical-ID boundary.

findings.name: God Bind (Festival)
findings.evidence: Independent skill page directly documents Festival unlock, Goku (Super Saiyan God) usage, Super/Ki Blast classification, 100 Ki cost, and CaC unavailability.

findings.name: Egret Waltz (Festival)
findings.evidence: Independent Videl (DB Super) preset page places Egret Waltz (Festival) in the character's second preset.

findings.name: Gamma Force: Code-R (Festival)
findings.evidence: Independent technique page identifies Gamma Force: Code-R as Gamma 1's Xenoverse 2 Super Skill and documents its Festival max-camaraderie appearance.

findings.name: Gamma Force: Code-B (Festival)
findings.evidence: Independent technique page identifies Gamma Force: Code-B as Gamma 2's Xenoverse 2 Super Skill and documents its Festival max-camaraderie appearance.

identifier_boundary: The new evidence confirms identity, classification, user/preset linkage, and (for God Bind) numeric cost, but still does not expose a canonical internal skill identifier. No ID is inferred from filename, preset position, or mod attachment naming.
next: Search surviving structured/datamined sources for the actual internal identifiers or historical canonical records; if none are recoverable, move to the next unresolved canonical enrichment field rather than manufacturing IDs.
